note: One chosen terminology set, applied everywhere. The content lint fails any string that uses a listed `avoid` form. Newcomer-facing definitions double as the codex's first-use explanations (§3.6).

terms.definition: A living worm that performs one fixed effect. A Gu Master keeps Gu inside their aperture and spends primeval essence to activate them.
Someone with an opened aperture who can keep and use Gu.
The space opened inside a Gu Master at awakening. It holds primeval essence and the Gu bound to it.
The fuel spent to activate a Gu. Every ability in this game shows its cost before you use it.
How much essence an aperture can hold. Aptitude sets it as a percentage, and Fang Yuan's is forty-four.
The currency. Gu food, refinements and bribes are all paid in stones, and the game expects you to count them.
A grade from A to D read out at awakening. It sets the size of the primeval sea and, as far as the clan is concerned, the size of the person.
Cultivation ranks run from one upward, each with four small stages: initial, middle, upper and peak.
One of the four stages inside a rank. Advancing one is a breakthrough, and this game stages breakthroughs as rituals.
Combining Gu and ingredients into a stronger Gu. Canonical refinements always succeed eventually; optional recipes can fail outright.
A dead cultivator's hidden legacy, usually a sequence of tests that each hand you what the next one demands.
A flower grown to hold a Gu inside an inheritance.
Cultivation that refuses the righteous path's obligations. It is a description of method, not an insult, and Fang Yuan treats it as neither.
What a body has left. The Nine Leaf Vitality Grass is the only thing that restores it, and it is gone before the end.
The mountain the Gu Yue clan holds, named for its straight, spear-tipped bamboo.
